note: The session's web search allowance ran out after the first few searches, so campaign websites were found from the links the Utah Republican Party's '2026 Republican Candidates' page and the Utah Democratic Party's 'Common Sense Candidates' page put on each candidate's name or card (these pages are listed in ballot/lean/ut_endorsements.json as support, not endorsements), and each site was then opened to check it names the candidate and the office. Judges' facts come from the Utah State Courts' own biography pages. No Utah party page endorses a 2026 state race, so endorsed_by is empty throughout. Sitting legislators were checked for a website only. Not found or not confirmed: Candice B. Pierucci (candicepierucci.com, linked from the party page, answered 403 to the kit's fetcher and to WebFetch); Natassja Grossman (natassjagrossman.com, linked from the Democratic page, is drawn entirely by script and showed no name or office); Rebecca Winsor (no link on the state or Washington County Democratic pages); Scott H Chew and Rex P Shipp (no link of their own on the party page). Michele Christiansen Forster's birth year on Wikipedia carries no citation, so it is left out. Blank means not found, not that nothing exists.
